create_joint_instance: create a Joint instance with a name and optional parent transform in the kinematic chain
count_joints_in_chain: recursively count all Joint children in a joint's kinematic chain including the root joint
get_chain_worldspace_positions: get the xyz worldspace coordinates of all joints in the kinematic chain as a flat list
get_chain_joint_names: traverse the joint chain in depth-first order and return a list of all joint names
update_joint_transforms: update the joint's local and world transform matrices by calling update_transforms with ancestor propagation
